instruction: Examine the book reading spreadsheet on the desktop for 2022 data. Find the book with the highest 5-star rating that belongs to the Science Fiction genre. Open 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop and write the book title there.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task asks to find a 5-star rated Science Fiction book. From data: Science Fiction books are at rows 5, 7, 8. Only 'The Andromeda Strain' (Row 8) has 5.0 rating. Verified by checking all genre and rating combinations.
